criteria.1.1: 1.1 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5, cart A holds 3 MUG-01, and cart B adds 3 MUG-01 THEN the system accepts the add without an error
criteria.1.2: 1.2 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5, cart A holds 3 MUG-01, and cart B adds 3 MUG-01 THEN the system reports available for MUG-01 as -1
criteria.1.3: 1.3 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5, cart A holds 3 MUG-01, and cart B posts 3 MUG-01 to `/carts/<id>/lines` THEN the system returns status 200
criteria.2.1: 2.1 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5, cart A holds 3 MUG-01, and cart B adds 3 MUG-01 THE SYSTEM SHALL raise `OutOfStock`
criteria.2.2: 2.2 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5, cart A holds 3 MUG-01, and cart B adds 3 MUG-01 THE SYSTEM SHALL keep available for MUG-01 at 2
criteria.2.3: 2.3 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5, cart A holds 3 MUG-01, and cart B posts 3 MUG-01 to `/carts/<id>/lines` THE SYSTEM SHALL return status 409
criteria.3.1: 3.1 WHEN one reserve asks for more units than the initial stock of a sku THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO raise `OutOfStock`
criteria.3.2: 3.2 WHEN a reserve asks for a qty less than 1 THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO raise `ValueError`
criteria.3.3: 3.3 WHEN release is called with any qty THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO keep available at or below the initial stock of that sku
criteria.3.4: 3.4 WHEN `Cart.remove` is called for a sku the cart holds THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO return that line's units to available
criteria.3.5: 3.5 WHEN the sum of all reserves for a sku stays at or below its initial stock THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO accept each reserve
